intro.fallback: Naruto learns that his companions have been kidnapped by Renga's men and will only be released if he turns over Haruna.

During this confrontation, it is revealed that the princess' father, shortly before his death, had confessed his regret of turning over the princess for the sake of his people and wished for the good of the people...
Haruna, having been influenced by Naruto and this revelation, offers to sacrifice herself to protect Naruto.

name.fallback: Forecast: Death! Cloudy with Chance of Sun!

text.fallback: Head out: Forecast: Death! Cloudy with Chance of Sun!

outro.fallback: Naruto defeats Renga by reflecting sunlight off his forehead protector, and learns that Shizune, Shikamaru and several Konoha ninja have rescued Hinata, Chōji and Yurinojō.
Haruna then succeeds her father as ruler of the Land of Vegetables, and Naruto and his companions return home.
